features.name: Group Karaoke Rooms
features.description: Host creates a karaoke room (big-screen YouTube player + live queue + join QR); guests scan QR on phones, get anonymous Better Auth sessions + nickname, search YouTube (Data API v3, "karaoke"-biased, results persisted to D1 song/search_log tables), add songs to a shared queue. Live state (queue/playback/roster) lives in a per-room raw Durable Object (KaraokeRoom, SQLite storage, WS hibernation — @cloudflare/actors was spiked and rejected as immature); D1 keeps durable room records + played-song history. Host controls play/pause/skip/volume/reorder (dnd-kit); reorder rights gated by per-room allowGuestReorder toggle; rooms auto-close after 1h idle via a DO alarm.
features.evidence: Phases 1-6 complete 2026-07-16. Plan plans/group-karaoke.html (reviewed, 4 decisions). PR #1 merged to main. Feature wall-clock ~1h 55m (first commit → merge).

features.name: Party Screen Cinema
features.description: Rethink the playing state of /room/:code as a cinema — the video is the hero, everything else is instrumentation. (1) Playing state pins itself to the dark theater surface regardless of app theme (lobby/dashboard/landing still follow the theme). (2) Now-playing collapses from a 128px two-line block to a ~64px single-line bar: NOW SINGING eyebrow + cleaned 28px title + singer avatar chip, recovering ~10% of viewport height for the video. (3) New channel-aware cleanSongTitle helper (app/lib/song-title.ts) strips karaoke/quality noise and splits song from artist using the queue item's channel field to decide direction. (4) Right rail becomes one continuous instrument panel: guest avatar cluster band, UP NEXT list filling the middle with a top-anchored empty state, QR ticket stub at the bottom — removing the ~250px void an empty queue used to leave. Plus (approved from the plan's open questions) a NEXT UP callout on the first queued song and a quiet song-progress/remaining-time indicator on the TV. Plan: plans/party-screen-cinema.html (reviewed 2026-07-24, round 1, 4/4 decisions on recommended options + both open questions approved for exploration).
features.evidence: Plan reviewed 2026-07-24: always-dark playing surface; single-line now-playing bar; channel-aware title cleaning; rail as one instrument panel; next-up callout + progress indicator both approved to explore.
